text:
مدھرے چوڑے چگھرے، متھے اتے وٹ—
مرداں دیاں ایہ صفتاں؛ ناری چور چپٹ۔
romanized:
Madhré chauṛé chagghré, matthé utté vaṭṭ—
Mardā̃ dīā̃ éh siftā̃; nārī chōr chapaṭṭ.
literal_en:
Short and broad and stout, with wrinkles on the forehead—
These are characteristics of men; in a woman they are utterly bad.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
